purpose: Construct a failure-enriched development stress test after random Dev scaling produced a ceiling batch.

screening_baseline.role: Independent historical screen only; it is not an arm or control in the new experiment.

selection_rule: Start from every case listed as a confirmed Official failure in the pre-existing Dev bad-case census casebook.
Exclude failures whose recorded cause is unresolved or likely an intermittent empty package-index candidate set.
Exclude repositories already executed under an F+C_s+R target-replay treatment.
Include every remaining eligible case; do not rank by expected repairability, difficulty, treatment behavior, or repository contents.

claim_boundary: The cases were screened by an independent prior baseline, but their failure taxonomy also informed method development; this is a development stress test, not held-out evidence.
The new causal comparison is matched DeepSeek A-F versus DeepSeek B-FCsR. Historical Codex outcomes cannot be placed in the paired result table.
Results estimate behavior only in this failure-enriched stratum and cannot be converted into an overall Dev or EnvBench success rate.
